Claim 8 (Currently Amended): A composition comprising a lubricant comprising at least one selected from the group consisting of polyol ester and polyvinyl ether and a refrigerant comprising: from 1 to 99% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf); and from 1 to 99% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze), wherein said composition exhibits a Hazen color of about 200 or less as measured by ASHRAE test 97-2007 after a sealed glass tube comprising the composition is welded closed and placed in an oven at __175°C__ for 14 days.

Claim 9 (Original): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from polyols having a neopentyl backbone.

Claim 10 (Original): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a polyol selected from the group consisting of neopentyl glycol, trimethylolpropane, pentaerythritol and dipentaerythritol.

Claim 11 (Original): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a linear or branched carboxylic acid containing from 2 to 15 carbon atoms.

Claim 12 (Original): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from at least one linear or branched carboxylic acid selected from the group consisting of n-pentanoic acid, n-hexanoic acid, n-heptanoic acid, n-octanoic acid, 2-ethylhexanoic acid, 2,2-dimethylpentanoic acid, 3,5,5-trimethylhexanoic acid, adipic acid and succinic acid.

Claim 13 (Original): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a linear or branched carboxylic acid containing from 5 to 9 carbon atoms.

Claim 14 (Original): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the composition comprises from 10 to 50% by weight of the at least one polyol ester.

Claim 15 (Original): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises at least one PVE, wherein the at least one PVE is a copolymer of the following two units: Unit 1: Unit 2:

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): The composition according to Claim __15__, wherein the copolymer comprises from 50 to 95% by weight of Unit 1.

Claim 17 (Original): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from 5 to 45% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from 55 to 95% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze).

Claim 18 (Original): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from 15 to 45% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from 55 to 85% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze).

Claim 19 (Original): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from 15 to 35% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from 65 to 85% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze).

Claim 20 (Original): The composition according to Claim 17, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from polyols having a neopentyl backbone.

Claim 21 (Original): The composition according to Claim 17, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a linear or branched carboxylic acid containing from 5 to 9 carbon atoms.

Claim 22 (Original): The composition according to Claim 17, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from at least one linear or branched carboxylic acid selected from the group consisting of n-pentanoic acid, n-hexanoic acid, n-heptanoic acid, n-octanoic acid, 2-ethylhexanoic acid, 2,2-dimethylpentanoic acid, 3,5,5-trimethylhexanoic acid, adipic acid and succinic acid.

Claim 23 (Original): The composition according to Claim 18, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a linear or branched carboxylic acid containing from 5 to 9 carbon atoms.

Claim 24 (Original): The composition according to Claim 18, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from at least one linear or branched carboxylic acid selected from the group consisting of n-pentanoic acid, n-hexanoic acid, n-heptanoic acid, n-octanoic acid, 2-ethylhexanoic acid, 2,2-dimethylpentanoic acid, 3,5,5-trimethylhexanoic acid, adipic acid and succinic acid.

Claim 25 (Currently Amended): The composition according to claim __8__, wherein the refrigerant further comprises 1,1,1,2-tetrafluoroethane.

Claim 26 (Original): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a pentaerythritol ester.
